name: Eligible Counterpart 3
definition: Represents a party to be identified as eligible for the instructing party.

IssuerIdentification.name: Issuer Identification
IssuerIdentification.definition: Unique business identifier code used to identify the party providing the eligible counterpart information.

EligibleCounterpartIdentification.name: Eligible Counterpart Identification
EligibleCounterpartIdentification.definition: Unique business identifier code used to identify the central securities depository to be defined as eligible.

ValidFrom.name: Valid From
ValidFrom.definition: Date from when the eligible counterpart is valid.

ValidTo.name: Valid To
ValidTo.definition: Date until when the eligible counterpart is valid.

EligibilityIdentification.name: Eligibility Identification
EligibilityIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the eligible counterpart party.
